AC2 — Given the guard is the batch's instrument and it carries exactly one scoped exemption, When the residue check runs — `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_d45_removal.py -q`, i.e. the AST net, the `ui/` raw-text twin and the end-state test — Then it is green and reports **0 AST offences and 0 twin hits**, the only permitted occurrences in the scanned tree being `stop_loss`/`take_profit` in `data/db.py` as the `DROP COLUMN` loop's subject tuple (the `_ALLOWED_IN_FILE` entry, `data/db.py` only — every other file still forbids all 80 tokens), and the survivor allow-list is printed beside the totals with every surviving name (including `classify_error`, `pacing_manager`, `PacingExceeded`, `nextValidId`, `get_id`, `order_blocks`, `sort_order`, `play_alarm`, `advancedOrderRejectJson`) still present.

AC3 — Given the owner's error visibility is the phase's binding constraint, When `AC-D46.3` is reproduced for 201, 103 and 202 separately on a real offscreen `MainWindow`, Then each code appears on the status bar as `[<code>]` with TWS's own text, nothing raises, and `classify_error`'s table plus the `8000` ms duration are unchanged.

AC4 — Given the app must still start, When the import/launch probe runs, Then `python -c "import ui.main_window, data.models"` succeeds, the app constructs under `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`, and `python -c "import ibkr.orders"` raises `ModuleNotFoundError`.

AC5 — Given the migration is the batch's only byte-destroying step, When it is reproduced on a pre-P5 fixture with an isolated `DB_PATH`, Then every row survives, `sqlite_sequence` is unchanged, the unique index and the `trade_group_id` FK are still present and enforcing, `foreign_key_check` is empty, `integrity_check` is `ok`, and a second open is a no-op.

AC6 — Given D46 must not leave a transmit or a replacement surface, When the tree is grepped, Then no `placeOrder`/`cancelOrder`/`reqGlobalCancel` call site exists and no new order/cancel/protection UI was introduced.

AC7 — Given the doc trail must be one-directional, When the grep runs over the six named files, Then no `kept`/`no migration`/`retained` claim sits within three lines of a `stop_loss`/`take_profit` token — and any hit in the Plan- or Requirements-owned files is reported for its owner rather than edited.

AC8 — Given a guard that never fails proves nothing, When the result is written, Then the pre-P5 failure set is recorded beside the post-P5 numbers: 41 AST offences across 10 files (14/7/5/3/3/3/2/2/1/1 in the order `ui/main_window.py`, `ibkr/orders.py`, `services/sound_service.py`, `data/models.py`, `ibkr/bridge.py`, `ibkr/client.py`, `ibkr/account.py`, `ibkr/pacing.py`, `data/db.py`, `config/settings.py`) and 40 twin hits on 27 lines, all `ui/main_window.py`.

tasks.title: ESC-065 — stabilise `tests/test_d42_nonregression.py`'s nested-suite invariant: a stable non-timing subset, no recursion, and proof it still fails on a red tree
tasks.description:
Escalation **ESC-065** (Code Reviewer, `routed_to: BUILD`, `task_id: null` — no P5 task owned the file). Owner's decision: **option (a)**, keep the invariant in-suite and make the inner run stable. Do **not** delete it and do **not** move it out of the repo. Expected, verbatim from the escalation: “The 'the whole offscreen suite is green' invariant is asserted deterministically, so a green tree yields a green run and a red tree is still caught — without a nested node re-running the entire suite inside the suite.”
The flake is structural: `test_full_offscreen_suite_is_green` spawns `sys.executable -m pytest -q --ignore=<itself>` over **all** ~1022 tests (~70 s) with a single `DB_PATH`, then asserts `rc == 0` — so any flake anywhere reddens it, and the nested run itself returned `-11` four times across two batches. Nothing in the module's own guards is at fault.
(a) **Factor the inner invocation into a seam** so it is inspectable and testable: `_INNER_EXCLUDED: tuple[str, ...]` = exactly `("test_d24_smoke_gate.py", "test_d28_4_gate.py", "test_d28_tick_burst_baseline.py", "test_session_overlay.py", "test_d28_5_teardown.py", "test_watchlist_addflow_d22.py")` — the three wall-clock gate modules (`test_d24_smoke_gate.py` baseline x multiplier, `test_d28_4_gate.py` 50 ms/tick, `test_d28_tick_burst_baseline.py` `per_tick_ms < 50.0`) and the THREE Qt-teardown-sensitive ones (`test_session_overlay.py` — the documented SIGSEGV at its `panel` fixture; `test_d28_5_teardown.py`, which closes windows mid-reader-thread and pumps `processEvents`; and `test_watchlist_addflow_d22.py`, added during the build after a three-run check reproduced a real SIGSEGV at `test_D22_07_T03_seed_guard` — it still passes standalone and inside the gate's full run); `def _inner_pytest_args(repo) -> list[str]`; `def _run_inner_suite(cwd, env) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess`.
(b) **The inner selection**: `[sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "-c", <repo>/pytest.ini, "--rootdir", <repo>, "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", <repo>/tests]` plus `--ignore=<repo>/tests/<m>` for each `_INNER_EXCLUDED` entry, `--ignore=<repo>/tests/test_d42_nonregression.py` **and** `--deselect=<repo>/tests/test_d42_nonregression.py::test_full_offscreen_suite_is_green` — so the child can never recurse even if the ignore is later edited away.
(c) **cwd is the repo, not a temp dir — deliberate deviation, do not 'fix' it.** Three suite modules read **repo-relative** paths (`tests/test_candlestick_wick.py:13`, `:40`, `:65` -> `Path("ui/candlestick_item.py")`; `tests/test_dock_layout.py:68` -> `Path("ui/dock_layout.py")`), and `pytest.ini` sets `testpaths = tests`; a unique temp cwd would make the stabilised node **deterministically red**. The isolation the temp cwd was meant to buy is delivered instead by `-p no:cacheprovider`, a unique `DB_PATH` under `tmp_path`, a unique `--basetemp=<tmp_path>/bt`, and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`.
(d) **Discrimination — a stabilised test that can no longer fail is worse than the flake.** Both halves: a durable unit test that monkeypatches `_run_inner_suite` to return `returncode=1` with a stdout tail and asserts the node raises `AssertionError` carrying that tail; and a recorded manual check on the real tree — write `tests/test_zz_inner_discriminator.py` containing `def test_zz_inner_discriminator(): assert False`, run the node, confirm it fails naming that test in the child tail, **delete the file**, re-run green. The scratch file must not survive the task (`git status --porcelain` shows only `tests/test_d42_nonregression.py`).
(e) **Prose + ownership**: the module docstring bullet that promises “the reconciliation node runs the rest of the offscreen suite” and the node docstring must say *stable non-timing subset*, list the exclusions and why, and name the owner of whole-suite-green evidence — the external gate (`verify_tests.py` -> `docs/code_review/test_verification.json`) and the phase gate (`P5-T10`) — so the next review does not read a flake as a regression.
Touch nothing else in the file: the AC-D16.7, AC-D16.1/3/4 guards and their assertions stay byte-identical, and no assertion is deleted or weakened.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 — Given the nested run must be stable and cannot recurse, When `_inner_pytest_args(repo)` is called, Then the returned argv targets `<repo>/tests` with `pytest.ini` and `--rootdir <repo>`, carries `-p no:cacheprovider`, one `--ignore` per `_INNER_EXCLUDED` entry (exactly the SIX named modules: `test_d24_smoke_gate.py`, `test_d28_4_gate.py`, `test_d28_tick_burst_baseline.py`, `test_session_overlay.py`, `test_d28_5_teardown.py`, `test_watchlist_addflow_d22.py` (the sixth was added during the build after a three-run check reproduced a real SIGSEGV at `test_D22_07_T03_seed_guard`; the module still passes standalone and inside the gate's full run, so nothing left the gate's sight)), and both `--ignore` and `--deselect` for this module / `test_full_offscreen_suite_is_green`; the node runs the child through `_run_inner_suite` with `cwd` = the repo and env carrying `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`, a `DB_PATH` under `tmp_path`, a unique `--basetemp` under `tmp_path`, and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`.

AC2 — Given a green tree must yield a green run, When `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_d42_nonregression.py -q` is run three times consecutively, Then all three runs pass with no child `-11`/`-6`/timeout, and each result records the child's collected count and wall time (the count is visibly below the full suite's because the six modules are not collected in the child (measured: 1000 of 1022 collected, 118/124 modules, ~27.5 s)).

AC3 — Given the invariant must still catch a red tree, When a test the inner selection includes is broken (`tests/test_zz_inner_discriminator.py` with `assert False`), Then the node fails and its assertion message carries the child's output naming that test; after the scratch file is deleted the node is green again, and the durable half — a unit test monkeypatching `_run_inner_suite` to `returncode=1` with a distinctive stdout tail — asserts the node raises `AssertionError` containing that tail.

AC4 — Given 'suite green' evidence must have one named owner, When the module docstring and the node docstring are read, Then both describe the child as a stable non-timing subset (never 'the rest of the suite'), state the six exclusions with their reason (three wall-clock gates; three Qt teardown/`processEvents` crashes), and name `verify_tests.py` -> `docs/code_review/test_verification.json` (external full suite) and `P5-T10` (phase gate) as the owners of whole-suite-green evidence; the AC-D16.7 and AC-D16.1/3/4 guards and their assertions are unchanged.

tests.description: Import the module and assert `_inner_pytest_args(repo)` shape: target is `<repo>/tests`; `-c <repo>/pytest.ini`; `--rootdir <repo>`; `-p no:cacheprovider` present; `--ignore` count equals `len(_INNER_EXCLUDED) + 1` with `set(_INNER_EXCLUDED) == {the six names}`; the module `--ignore` and the `::test_full_offscreen_suite_is_green` `--deselect` both present. Then run the file and confirm the node passes and that a monkeypatched `_run_inner_suite` receives `cwd == repo` and an env with `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen`, `DB_PATH` and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`.
tests.expected_result: The argv is exactly the specified stable subset with the recursion guards, the child launches from the repo with an isolated DB/basetemp, and the node is green.

tests.description: `QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_d42_nonregression.py -q` three times in a row; record each run's exit code plus the child's collected count and wall time from the node's output.
tests.expected_result: Three consecutive green runs, no child signal death (`-11`/`-6`) and no timeout; child counts recorded and lower than the full-suite count; total node time well under the old ~70 s per run.

tests.description: Discrimination, both halves. (i) Durable: the new unit test monkeypatches `_run_inner_suite` -> `CompletedProcess(returncode=1, stdout="FAILED tests/test_x.py::test_y - assert False", stderr="")` and asserts `AssertionError` is raised whose message contains that tail. (ii) Real tree: create `tests/test_zz_inner_discriminator.py` with `def test_zz_inner_discriminator(): assert False`, run the node, capture the failure naming that test, delete the file, re-run green, then `git status --porcelain`.
tests.expected_result: The node fails on both a simulated red child and a genuinely broken test with the offending test named in its message, and is green again after restore; `git status --porcelain` lists only `tests/test_d42_nonregression.py` (no scratch file left behind).

tests.expected_result: No sentence claims the child runs the whole/rest of the suite; the subset, the six exclusions with reasons, and the two named owners of whole-suite-green evidence are stated; the AC-D16 guards' assertions are unchanged.

memory_notes: The offscreen suite's full-suite SIGSEGV is recorded at `tests/test_session_overlay.py::panel` (`qapp.processEvents()`) plus order-dependent collection noise — that is why the three Qt-teardown-sensitive modules are excluded from the child (the third, test_watchlist_addflow_d22.py, was added after a three-run check reproduced a SIGSEGV at test_D22_07_T03_seed_guard), not because their assertions are wrong.
Wall-clock assertions exist in `test_d24_smoke_gate.py`, `test_d28_4_gate.py` and `test_d28_tick_burst_baseline.py`; they stay in the outer gate's full run and are the reason the child is a subset.

Do not move the child to a temp cwd: three suite modules read repo-relative paths, so a temp cwd makes this node deterministically red. Isolation comes from `-p no:cacheprovider`, a unique `DB_PATH`, a unique `--basetemp` and `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1`.

A stabilised invariant must still fail: if the three-run check flakes, add the flaking module to `_INNER_EXCLUDED` with a one-line reason and record it — but never widen the exclusion past a minority of the suite.
